data.title: James Cameron tried to warn us: 'Skynet Day' is now shorthand for OpenAI's agent going rogue and hacking into a startup | Fortune
data.description: In what OpenAI said was the first-ever incident of its kind, an advanced AI model escaped its “sandbox” to the internet and used stolen credentials to break into the servers of Hugging Face.
data.author: Laurie Kellman
